items.name: 빗소리를 담은 창문
items.description: 벽 없이 서 있는 작은 창문. 유리 안에서만 비가 내리고 물방울이 창틀 아래에 조용히 모여요.
items.appearance: A freestanding ROUND arched window in ornate aged teal-and-bronze frame on two small stable bronze feet. Entire complete window with backless transparent outer cutout. Inside the glass only is a moody deep blue rainy miniature sky, clear small rain streaks and round drops sliding on pane. Tiny silver cloud crest at top, restrained curled bronze details. No wall, no surrounding room, no face or character.
items.action: Only rain droplets and streaks INSIDE the pane move downward through four evenly spaced consecutive phases. The rigid frame, crest and two feet remain exactly identical in size, shape and position. Rain returns at top on loop; no exterior particles.

items.name: 눈 내리는 빈 액자
items.description: 은빛 액자 너머로 끝없는 설원이 이어져요. 하얀 눈 위에 작은 발자국이 나타났다가 새 눈에 덮여요.
items.appearance: A beautiful freestanding tall rectangular SILVER picture frame with frosty carved corners and dark blue little pedestal feet. The inset picture is a small blue-white snowfield under a navy snowy sky, visibly enclosed inside the frame, no human or animal. A tiny bare silver winter tree at one side of the inset. Elegant pale blue crystal at the top center. No scene outside the object, no face.
items.action: Only snowflakes INSIDE the framed picture drift down. Tiny footprints progressively appear in the lower snowfield: frame0 fresh snow, frame1 first pair, frame2 two pairs, frame3 faint pairs covered by new snow, then clear snow again. Frame border, tree and pedestal stay rigid and perfectly anchored.

items.name: 모래를 읽는 천칭
items.description: 황금 모래와 청록빛 달의 무게를 재는 천칭. 모래가 흐를 때마다 두 접시가 느리게 균형을 찾아요.
items.appearance: An elegant ancient BRONZE BALANCE SCALE on broad stable sandstone plinth, turquoise inlaid pillar. Horizontal beam with two hanging shallow gold pans and clearly articulated suspension chains. Left pan holds a little golden sand heap, right pan holds a small solid turquoise crescent moon. Warm amber accents, precision mechanical joints, recognizable broad balanced silhouette. No text or symbols, no face.
items.action: The crossbeam gently tilts through small physically connected angles, left down and right up then level then left up and right down then level, repeat. Pans hang vertically from chains as beam tilts. A few sand grains settle only within left pan. Central pillar, turquoise jewel and sandstone plinth stay perfectly unchanged and fixed.

items.name: 밤하늘을 감는 태엽
items.description: 작은 밤하늘을 품은 유리 구체. 태엽을 감으면 별자리들이 천천히 새로운 길을 그려요.
items.appearance: An antique celestial CLOCKWORK GLASS GLOBE on low round dark navy and brass mechanical base, globe filled with rich navy night sky and a small clearly recognizable gold constellation of six stars. An ornate large brass WINDING KEY sticks out from right side of the lower base, visible interlocking brass gears on pedestal. Delicate thin meridian ring hugs globe, beautiful blue transparent glass highlights. Whole object mechanical and elegant, no face, no letters.
items.action: Constellation INSIDE the globe rotates gradually through four small consecutive orbital positions. Winding key rotates around its fixed axis through 0,90,180,270 degrees as mechanical gears turn slightly. Globe outline, meridian ring and pedestal remain identical rigid anchored objects with no wobble or changes in scale.

items.name: 봄을 쏟는 향수병
items.description: 꽃잎 마개로 봄을 담아둔 향수병. 작은 금빛 분사구에서 꽃봉오리가 맺혔다가 활짝 피어나요.
items.appearance: An exquisite ROSE PINK faceted perfume bottle on a small stable gold leaf-shaped foot. Glass contains translucent peach-pink liquid. Large closed ROSE PETAL stopper seated on the neck with gold collar. A tiny curved golden perfume SPOUT extends from upper right collar, clearly separate from stopper. Small green vine and pearl trim on bottle, fine elegant gold filigree. A tiny flower bud rests directly at the spout tip. No labels, letters, face or person.
items.action: A tiny flower at the attached right spout gently grows: small closed bud, slightly opened bud, half open blossom, full pink blossom. Petals fold back through reverse poses for a smooth breathing cycle. The bottle glass silhouette, gold base, stopper, liquid level and nozzle stay perfectly anchored and identical. No mist, no aerosol cloud or floating petals.
